An isolationist faction rendered as such through several cycles of crisis, the so-called 'Adversary' is all that remains of an ambitious project long abandoned. In the aftermath of the Second AI War, an unknown individual, motivated by relief from constant warfare, founded multiple independent colonies in a then-unexplored star system, hoping to usher the Persean Sector into a new era of peace and prosperity. A few cycles later, they mysteriously vanished, leaving behind a bitter legacy tainted by conflict and suffering. Before the founder's disappearance, the Sector's dominant powers, threatened by the notion of an upstart polity disrupting the precarious status quo, had sent numerous expeditions against the newly-founded colonies, endangering the very existence of its inhabitants. Against all odds, the polity survived - but its idealism has not.

To this day, the people under the Adversary's banner remain defiant and proud, protecting what they see as the only lasting utopia in humanity's storied history - a conviction mostly sustained by the Adversary's military might and the shameless use of recovered Domain-era technology. Relentless raids and invasions have made the embattled defenders unwilling to make amends with almost anyone in the Sector, though a tiny minority of detractors still remain, striving to fulfill their founder's vision of unity amidst the senseless chaos and destruction.
